figures.alt: A schematic diagram of the stern-gerlach experiment.Silver atoms leave an oven and travel between 2 magnets. They have different shape, the top one is like a pencil cross section and labelled S. The bottom is concave and labelled N., behind the magnets is a screen , showing that the silver atoms arrive in an oval, where the top ones are spin up atoms and the bottom are spin down.
figures.caption: schematic diagram of the stern-gerlach experiment.Silver atoms leave an oven and travel between 2 magnets. They have different shapes so that the magnetic field between them varies over space which means that a force will be exerted depending on the magnetic moment of the silver atoms

attrs.description: Experiment demonstrating that there a 2 distinct magnetic moment directions on an atom. (Quantise spin)
